findings.title: Unintended 10x increase in cleanup frequency
findings.body: pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go line 77 changes the background ticker from 10 minutes to 1 minute with no mention in the PR description. This affects all cleanup jobs (snapshots, dashboard versions, images, annotations, invites, short URLs, query history), increasing DB and IO load 10x in production and partially defeating the deadlock-reduction goal. It looks like leftover debugging and should be reverted.

findings.title: Leftover Error-level debug logging with full ID lists
findings.body: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go lines 534, 537, 554, 557, 576, 579 call r.log.Error on every cleanup batch for normal operation, logging count, full ids slice (up to AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize, e.g. 32767 IDs), cond, and a nil err. This will emit Error-level false alarms on every run (now every minute), with huge log lines causing log volume, CPU, disk and ingestion cost, and can mask real errors. These debug statements should be removed or demoted to Debug without dumping all IDs.
